title: Oven-Roasted Southern Thai Guanciale Fried-Rice
description: A resinous, crisp fried rice with smoky guanciale, tangy tamarind, and zesty lime, perfect for monsoon Thai vibes and FODMAP-friendly meals.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Dice the guanciale into thin strips and spread them on the prepared sheet.
Roast the guanciale for 20 minutes until crisp, then set aside to cool.
In a large skillet, heat sesame oil over medium heat and sauté the carrots and green beans for 4 minutes.
Add the minced ginger and tamarind paste, cooking for another minute until fragrant.
Push the vegetables to one side of the skillet, crack the eggs on the empty side, and scramble until set.
Stir in the cooked rice, roasted guanciale, fish sauce, soy sauce, and lime zest, mixing until everything is evenly coated.
Season with salt and pepper, then sprinkle chopped chives over the top.
Serve hot, garnishing with extra lime zest if desired.
